high_pole.base_text: My dog passed away last week from old age and I've been really missing him. I don't think I can ever have another pet.
high_pole.neutral_paraphrase: My dog died last week due to old age and I have noticed his absence. I do not plan to get another pet.
high_pole.emotion_rewrite: My dog passed away last week and the house feels so empty now. I'm not sure if I'll ever want another pet.

high_pole.base_text: Steve, when are you going back to America? Next week. Wow, so soon! I'm going to miss you.
high_pole.neutral_paraphrase: Steve, when are you going back to America? Next week. That is soon. I will notice your absence.
high_pole.emotion_rewrite: Steve, when are you going back to America? Next week... It's hard to believe you’ll be leaving so quickly. I’m really going to miss you.

high_pole.base_text: My tooth is shaking and i think will fall off. Its not like am a kid and it will grow again
high_pole.neutral_paraphrase: My tooth is loose and I think it will fall out. I am not a child, so it will not grow back.
high_pole.emotion_rewrite: My tooth is shaking and could fall out, and it just feels discouraging knowing it won't come back like when I was a kid.

high_pole.base_text: I saved up for so long to buy my car. 5 days after I got it, it was totaled when someone hit it in a parking lot.
high_pole.neutral_paraphrase: I saved money over a long period to buy my car. Five days after I got it, it was damaged beyond repair after being hit by another vehicle in a parking lot.
high_pole.emotion_rewrite: After putting in so much effort to save, it’s heartbreaking that the car got totaled just days after I bought it.

high_pole.base_text: My grandma was transferred to hospice care. I have always been so close to her.
high_pole.neutral_paraphrase: My grandma was transferred to hospice care. I have had a longstanding close relationship with her.
high_pole.emotion_rewrite: My grandma was moved to hospice care, and it’s hard knowing she’s getting closer to the end; I’ve always been so close to her.

low_pole.base_text: A homeless person begged me for money the other day. I wasn't sure if I should give it to him because I didn't want him to spend it on drugs or something
low_pole.neutral_paraphrase: A homeless person asked me for money recently. I was uncertain about giving it to him because I considered he might use it for substances or similar purposes.
low_pole.emotion_rewrite: A homeless person begged me for money the other day, and it made me feel kind of down about how hard life must be for them.

low_pole.base_text: How can I tell her about this ?  Don't worry , you'll find a way .  There is no need to be so frustrated .  How can you live without job in the future ?  Don't worry , you'll find a way .
low_pole.neutral_paraphrase: How can I tell her about this? You will find a way. There is no need to be impatient. How will you live without a job in the future? You will find a way.
low_pole.emotion_rewrite: It feels heavy to think about telling her—what if she can't understand?

low_pole.base_text: My friend has been a good dad for 2 decades. I'm sure his daughter will do well, when she goes off to college.
low_pole.neutral_paraphrase: My friend has been a father for 20 years. His daughter is expected to perform well when she goes to college.
low_pole.emotion_rewrite: He’s been a good dad for so long, and yet the thought of his daughter leaving for college feels a bit bittersweet.

low_pole.base_text: I remember spring cleaning with my mom. She wold play the same song all day. Now I do that too!
low_pole.neutral_paraphrase: I remember spring cleaning with my mom. She played the same song all day. Now I do the same.
low_pole.emotion_rewrite: I miss those spring cleaning days with my mom—hearing that same song all day now just brings a quiet ache.

low_pole.base_text: When my grandmother crocheted a blanket for me as a child, it became one of my most prized possessions. It is a beautiful pink and blue blanket. I have given it to my daughter now for her to enjoy.
low_pole.neutral_paraphrase: When my grandmother crocheted a blanket for me as a child, I valued it highly. It is a pink and blue blanket. I have given it to my daughter for her use.
low_pole.emotion_rewrite: The pink and blue blanket my grandmother crocheted for me as a child was so special; giving it to my daughter now feels like the end of a chapter.
